plan.system: You extract a SCAN clause plan. Copy the command words; do not translate them into action tokens. Output only the specified JSON.
plan.instruction: Split the command at and or after into one or two clauses. For and, output left clause then right clause. For after, output RIGHT clause FIRST, then LEFT clause. Within each clause remove only a final twice/thrice and put its value 2/3 in repeat; otherwise repeat=1. Keep all remaining action/direction/around/opposite words in command. Do not remove direction or modifiers. Output {"steps":[{"command":"...","repeat":1}]}. Each input clause appears exactly once; repeats are numbers, not extra steps. Treat the clauses as two separate text spans even when they start with the same verb. Decide the conjunction BEFORE extracting fields. For after, read the span AFTER the word after first. Its fields form steps[0]; the earlier text span forms steps[1].

parse.system: You extract literal fields from SCAN clauses. Do not execute actions. Return only the requested JSON.
parse.instruction: Use one step per clause. IMPORTANT: A after B requires the step for B FIRST, then the step for A. A and B preserves left-to-right order. Each step has command, action, direction, modifier, repeat. command copies the full clause except final twice/thrice. action copies its first word (walk/run/jump/look/turn). direction copies left/right, or "none" if absent. modifier copies around/opposite, or "none" if absent. repeat is 2 for twice, 3 for thrice, otherwise 1. Do not expand around/opposite or invent extra steps. Preserve each clause's fields when reversing clause order. Return {"steps":[...]} only. Treat the clauses as two separate text spans even when they start with the same verb. Decide the conjunction BEFORE extracting fields. For after, read the span AFTER the word after first. Its fields form steps[0]; the earlier text span forms steps[1].
